verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs claim 'Offer payment links' (adyen-docs-24) as a no-code checkout option, but there's no detail on dashboard self-serve setup, and independent community reports directly undercut the 'founder can start selling immediately' promise: Adyen reportedly 'refuses small clients, under the million' (adyen-comm-1), requires large reserves for subscription models (adyen-comm-6), and is described as 'bare metal' with integration complexity that keeps early-stage startups on Stripe instead (adyen-comm-5, adyen-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party walkthrough of dashboard payment-link creation, evidence of a frictionless founder-tier onboarding, and any rebuttal to the small-merchant rejection reports.
